verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Calendly *exposing* an MCP server so external AI agents can call Calendly's tools (docs-2, docs-5, docs-34, docs-35, probe-3) — this is the opposite direction from the story, which asks whether Calendly itself can plug in and consume external MCP servers' tools. No evidence shows Calendly (or its Callie assistant) acting as an MCP client that ingests third-party MCP servers.
